standard: Edge firewall session log (one row per session, written when the session ends)
cadence: per session, written when the session ends; sessions that carry a remote sign-on or a mail message are complete, the rest is a sample (about 1 in 40)
notes: One folder per organisation: city, nascc, brw, port, srmc, bcmc, county. Each organisation has its own products, rule names, zone names and habits; do not assume a value seen in one folder means the same in another. Hosts, addresses and accounts are in registries/partner_it_registry.json.

fields.name: time_utc
fields.notes: end of the session; start = time_utc - duration_s

fields.name: device
fields.notes: registry host_id of the firewall (the vendor has a second one in front of its hosted gateway)

fields.name: src_ip
fields.notes: internal addresses are registry hosts, or the organisation's VPN pool

fields.name: app
fields.notes: application the firewall identified (ssl, web-browsing, dns, ntp, smtp, ping, ...); - when it identified none

fields.name: bytes_sent
fields.notes: bytes from the source, including packet headers (larger than the web gateway's payload count for the same request)

fields.name: bytes_recv
fields.notes: bytes to the source, including packet headers

fields.name: nat_src_ip
fields.notes: public address an outbound session left from; empty for inbound sessions
